title: Man Hides a Small Bag in His Underwear, Gets Busted
description:
On April 7, 2021, a La Crosse police officer was dispatched to a welfare check. The complainant advised an individual was rolling into the intersection through a red light and the driver’s head was resting on the steering wheel. When the officer approached, he noticed his pupils were very small and nearly pinpoint. He searched the man and happened to find a particular small bag in a secrete location. 

For business inquiries or issues regarding an incident contact:
codebluecam@gmail.com

Code Blue Cam provides unbiased and authentic footage of incidents captured on body cams to report, inform, and educate viewers. The videos on this channel have been obtained through Public Records Requests.

🛑 The featured content is NOT intended to be violent or glorify violence in any way. We are sharing the footage STRICTLY for the purposes of news reporting and educating. 🛑
